track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 24: Neyriz
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Neyriz in Mahur, Nava, Rast-Panjgah. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ak3 and dwells most on B in Neyriz. The line peaks at Fs4 (361.8 Hz) at 1:08.4. It closes on the tonic (E4 → E4 → E4 → Fs4 → Fs4 → E3).
